nodes.question: Why is the juvenile stage of COTS considered a "black box" in understanding outbreaks?
nodes.answer: The early herbivorous juvenile stage of COTS is not well understood compared to the larval and adult stages, which are currently the focus of explanatory paradigms regarding outbreaks.
